core_obligations: State the dominance claim: for any dominant weight lambda in M^ast and any u in W^lambda (minimal length in the cosets of W/W_lambda), the weight eta^vee lambda + (u^-1(rho_ring) - rho_ring) is dominant (statement lines 791-798).

Prove it: pair against each alpha_i, i in I^ast; if u(alpha_i) is positive the inequality is immediate from dominance of lambda; if u(alpha_i) is negative, use the reduced expression of u ending in s_i, the lower bound (lambda, alpha_i) >= p with the type-dependent p, and the bound (rho_ring, -u(alpha_i)) + ||alpha_i||^2/2 <= p eta^vee (proof lines 800-841).
proof_roadmap: Positive case: (rho_ring, u(alpha_i)) >= ||alpha_i||^2/2 and eta^vee(lambda, alpha_i) >= 0 (proof lines 801-819).
Negative case: reduced expression u = u' s_i, the type-dependent lower bound p and the final inequality with qedhere (proof lines 819-841).
difficulty_reason: 800-841按u(alpha_i)正负分支；负分支使用以s_i结尾的约化表达及最短陪集代表性质取得类型相关p下界，与rho高度界结合证明dominance。保留H2。
